diagnostic.title: Finally understand your crown
diagnostic.subtitle: Answer a few questions: we build your hair profile and recommend an Awura routine.
diagnostic.hubSubtitle: Breakage, itchiness, dryness or a sensitive scalp with no clear answer? We guide you online or in person to understand your fiber and build lasting care.
diagnostic.hubPromise: Two formats, one goal: a clear report, a routine for textured hair, and the right Awura products — with the process to follow.
diagnostic.offersSubtitle: Choose the depth of analysis: a guided remote quiz, or a consultation with scalp observation via trichogram.
diagnostic.expertiseNote: Awura Beauty expertise for afro, coily and textured crowns — diagnostic, personalized routine, and natural care made for your fiber.

online.title: Online diagnostic
online.subtitle: A guided remote analysis to understand your crown’s needs and leave with a clear routine.
online.cardBody: Full remote analysis: profile, detailed feedback, process to follow, and links to products to buy.

includes.1: Guided questions on texture, scalp and goals
includes.2: Detailed feedback with wash-day / between-wash process
includes.3: New Awura routine with the right products
includes.4: Shop links + saved in your account

physical.title: In-person diagnostic
physical.subtitle: Face-to-face consultation: scalp observation with trichogram, then a personalized routine and product list.
physical.cardBody: Consultation with direct scalp observation (trichogram) for a complete report and tailored routine follow-up.

includes.3: Routine follow-up with gestures and cadence
includes.4: Proposed Awura product list, visible in your account

physical.slotsSubtitle: Pick a day, then a time. Duration is set by the Awura team.

physical.successBody: Thank you! Your appointment is booked. After the trichogram analysis, your report and personalized routine will appear in your account.

hydration.title: Deep hydration profile
hydration.summary: Your crown needs a rich nourishing routine. Prioritize moisture and sealing to restore fiber comfort.

growth.title: Active growth profile
growth.summary: Your goal leans toward length. A fortifying lotion and regular scalp care will be your allies.

repair.title: Intense repair profile
repair.summary: The fiber needs repair. Focus on reconstructing care and sealed hydration to limit breakage.

detangle.title: Detangle & definition profile
detangle.summary: Detangling and definition are central. A nourishing conditioner will ease your routines without stressing the fiber.

balance.title: Everyday balance profile
balance.summary: Your crown thrives on a balanced routine: cleanse gently, hydrate just enough, and seal for lasting comfort.
